instructions: Replace placeholders with the chosen subject and its invariants before changing style.
Use the prompt fields as a drawing brief or provider-neutral image prompt. Metadata is not visible image text.
Choose one primary branch; a secondary material must not replace the subject or primary structure.
The palette and lettering are choices for this brief, not universal Uniflora requirements.
Verify plant anatomy and exact text after production. Generated raster output is not automatically editable vector source.
Scope every exclusion to its brief. A logo's rejection of simulated glitch does not prohibit CRT distortion.

prompt.medium: [medium, aspect ratio, intended size, and use]
prompt.composition: [focal point, projection, spatial layers or flat hierarchy, negative space, symmetry or inversion, and crop]
prompt.palette: [dominant, supporting, and accent colors; note where accents are confined]
prompt.optics: [none, or a specific optical treatment tied to a visible material and focal relationship]
prompt.abstraction: [abstract concept translated into repeat interval, mirrored relationship, offset, layer reveal, or local spatial contradiction; distinguish literal from schematic]

text.placement: [optional reserved area for later editable text]
text.instructions: Use mode none or literal. When literal, fill the exact string and verify every character; a separate editable text layer is preferred.

exclusions: Do not replace the subject with generic occult marks, cyberpunk decoration, unmotivated noise, or a default glowing-mushroom scene.

biology.reference: [verified source and date, or no identifiable plants requested]
biology.instructions: Identifiable plants require reference-checked morphology. Label simplified work schematic; do not use an unchecked illustration for field identification.

motion.continuity: [for animation: preserve existing objects and scene identity; matching loop endpoint if required]
motion.accessibility: Provide a static alternative and pause control when animated; respect reduced motion; no flashes or rapid hue oscillation.
